Independent stewardship structure determined for launch

request.what: Phase 1 of 2 funding to take Bifrost from working testnet to launch readiness, including hardening, security audits, formal verification, ecosystem and partner readiness, and stewardship and economic foundations for launch.

claims.claim: Bifrost requests ₳12,332,031, approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA including a 10% refundable contingency, for a 9-month Phase 1 delivery period.
Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano SPOs that brings BTC onto Cardano as native fBTC for DeFi use cases.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access.
The proposal separates public rollout and 24 months of operations into a Phase 2 proposal planned for Q1 2027 after the bridge has been proven on-chain.
Bifrost custody is proposed to be distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs weighted by delegation, with fund movement requiring a cryptographic threshold representing a majority of delegated stake.
If SPO coordination fails, Bifrost would activate a federated mode as an operational fallback.
Bifrost says its smart contracts, off-chain tooling, and SDK are released under Apache 2.0 and that anyone can audit, fork, run, or build on the bridge without permission.

Bifrost is currently funded through Catalyst Fund 14 for ₳739,000, with approved milestones for architecture and early testnet work and a stated goal of proving the architecture end-to-end on testnet by August 2026.
The proposal targets 1,200 BTC of TVL, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets by Q2 2029 as its base contribution to Cardano 2030 KPIs.
The proposal states bridge fees in fBTC will fund operations and that surplus will be split to SPOs and the Cardano Treasury.

summary: The anchor describes a large treasury request for Phase 1 launch readiness of a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge, with substantial technical and economic claims but much of the key future value, security, and adoption evidence asserted rather than demonstrated in the supplied text.
